name: volibear-field-2
description: Best Volibear list against the Stuttgart RC Europe field (8 Nov 2026), asked by Jeremy on 12 Nov ("go c"). Volibear piloted by its specialist after 44 iterations of continuous training (spec_volibear_108_v0); the opponents are the six most played decks of the field (92% of the registered decks), weighted by decks registered, Riven split over two lists, each piloted by its specialist's current net (Riven spec_riven_120_v0; the general net for Master Yi and Rek'Sai). Starting lists: Ritualo's Dragons, the two lists of the 9 Nov searches, Laggy's Dragons with Rengar (Jeremy, 11 Nov) and the community lists. Caveat: the pilot trained on Ritualo's list and the 9 Nov search lists; it plays cards it never trained on (Rengar, Kinkou Initiate, Herald of Scales...) less well, so the search leans toward lists close to those. The search's own confirmation is 40 games per opponent; the finalists of all starts then meet on 200 games per opponent in a separate test. Start 2 of 6 (seed 1202).
